general.title: OMIX GSEA - Pre-ranked Gene Set Enrichment Analysis
general.instructions:
Performs Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) on pre-ranked gene lists using fgsea. Evaluates if gene sets are significantly enriched at either end of a ranking (e.g., fold-change, t-statistic).

**Required Inputs:**
• DEG Table with gene scores
• MSigDB or custom pathways database

**Outputs:**
• Enrichment results (NES, p-value, FDR)
• Leading edge genes for each pathway

datasets.name: DEG Table
datasets.description: Dataset with genes and ranking scores (e.g., t-statistic, log fold-change). Must contain a gene name column and score columns for each contrast.

datasets.name: Pathways Database
datasets.description: Gene set database (e.g., MSigDB v2023.2). Must have columns: collection, gene_set_name, gene_symbol, species.

parameters.name: Gene Names Column
parameters.help_text: Column name containing gene symbols in the DEG table

parameters.name: Species
parameters.help_text: Species for gene annotations in the DEG table

parameters.name: Gene Score Suffix
parameters.help_text: Suffix in column names containing gene ranking scores

parameters.name: Collections
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated MSigDB collections (e.g., 'H: hallmark gene sets,C2:CP:KEGG_LEGACY: KEGG Legacy gene sets'). See output log for available collections.
parameters.default_value: H: hallmark gene sets,C2:CP:REACTOME: Reactome gene sets

parameters.name: Min Geneset Size
parameters.help_text: Minimum number of genes in a gene set to include

parameters.name: Max Geneset Size
parameters.help_text: Maximum number of genes in a gene set to include

parameters.name: Number of Permutations
parameters.help_text: Number of permutations for p-value calculation (higher = more accurate but slower)

parameters.name: FDR Correction Mode
parameters.help_text: How to apply FDR correction: within each collection separately or across all collections

parameters.name: Collapse Redundancy
parameters.help_text: Use fgsea's collapsePathways to reduce redundant pathways

parameters.name: Sort By
parameters.help_text: Column to sort output results by

parameters.name: Image Width (pixels)
parameters.help_text: Width of output plots in pixels

parameters.name: Image Height (pixels)
parameters.help_text: Height of output plots in pixels
